messages:
Sam W: Hey team — first week here, trying to get access to AWS & GCP for dev work. I signed the access form but I still can’t assume the AWS role. Getting "AccessDenied" when I run `aws sts get-caller-identity` with the redwood profile. Any quick checks I should do?

Priya S: welcome Sam! :tada: Did you set up SSO with our Okta/IDP? Usually AccessDenied means either SSO not linked or you don’t have the `redwood-devs` role assigned.

Sam W: I did the SSO flow and the console login works, can open the console but CLI seems to fail. I followed the README command: `aws sso login --profile redwood`. After that I run `aws sts get-caller-identity --profile redwood` and get the error.

Cloud-Infra: Hey @Sam W — two quick things: 1) check your local AWS CLI v2 SSO cache (~/.aws/sso/cache) and confirm the profile name matches `redwood`. 2) Make sure the role ARN you assume is `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-devs` (we rotated account IDs for corp dev vs prod). If you wind up in the wrong account you’ll be denied.

Sam W: ok will check. Also on GCP — trying to access the `redwood-dev` project, but when I run `gcloud auth login` and then `gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-dev` it says permission denied. Who handles granting project-level roles?

Priya S: @Cloud-Infra usually grants GCP bindings for devs. For most engineers we add `roles/editor` on the dev project and specific roles (e.g., storage.objectAdmin) when needed. We try to avoid giving owner.

Cloud-Infra: Correct. I’ll check the request queue. @Sam W — can you paste the exact error message and the output of `gcloud auth list` (sanitized)? If you don’t have domain-scoped account we might need to add your identity as `user:sam@redwood.ai` to the project IAM.

Sam W: Error: "The caller does not have permission". `gcloud auth list` shows * sam@redwood.ai (active) *

Onboard-bot: Hi @Sam W — I see your onboarding form submitted 2026-03-21 09:14 UTC. Automated checklist: AWS SSO request: APPROVED, GCP project request: PENDING. Next step: cloud-ops will grant project IAM. Link to docs: https://internal.redwood.dev/onboarding/cloud-access

Josh L: re: AWS CLI SSO, sometimes the cached credentials are expired — try `aws sso login --profile redwood` again and then `export AWS_PROFILE=redwood` before running commands. Also confirm `~/.aws/config` has a `[profile redwood]` section with `sso_start_url` and `sso_region`.

Marta R: FYI @Sam W we also need your billing access scoped if you’ll touch infra that could spin up spend. If you need to create projects or provision GPUs we ask for temporary `billing.admin` on the billing account; otherwise we do it for you. Tell me what you need and I can file the billing IAM grant.

Sam W: Thanks everyone. For now I just need read/write on the dev project and the ability to push Docker images to the dev registry. Not provisioning infra.

Cloud-Infra: Good — I’ll add `roles/editor` + `roles/storage.admin` on the dev project and confirm registry permissions. Expect changes within the hour.

Sam W: Awesome, appreciate it. One last quick Q — any regional restrictions? I noticed some services blocked in `europe-west1` for compliance.

Priya S: Good catch — the policy is: prod workloads limited to `us-west2` and `europe-west1` is opt-in for some teams. For dev you can use `us-west2` and `us-central1`. If you need EU regions for testing ping infra with the use-case so they can approve.

Cloud-Infra: Update: I added the IAM bindings for `Sam W`: `roles/editor` and `roles/storage.admin` on `redwood-dev` project, and confirmed Docker registry push is allowed. Try again and reply here if anything else.

Sam W: Logged in and verified `gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-dev` now returns bindings with my email. `aws sts get-caller-identity --profile redwood` also works. Thanks team! :raised_hands:

Marta R: Billing note — I added you as `billing.viewer` for the dev billing account so you can see costs; reach out if you need temporary write access.

Priya S: Welcome to Redwood again — feel free to DM any of us for walkthroughs. We usually do a short infra orientation in week 1.

Sam W: Will do — thanks all!
